title: hat box
text: hat box. I have a larger hat that is really just for fun but wanted to keep it in some sort of form... so I ordered this hat "box."  It's a felt round with a clear vinyl zipper top.  I was disappointed to see the box it's self if so flimsy.  I am hoping the hat will help the box keep it's shape.  I was hoping for firm sides for the best protection.  This is really just a dust cover and you can HOPE your hat doesn't get crushed.  I needed something over 17" wide and I think I will keep looking - this one is just too flimsy.

features: 👒 REINFORCED WITH METAL FRAMES: Our collapsible storage bag comes with reinforced rods on the sides to protect the brim of your hats and to make the box stackable. The storage case (measuring 19"D x 11.5''H) inside provides a sturdy shape and the needed support while enhancing the longevity of the felt bag.

👒 COLLAPSIBLE HAT STORAGE BOX: Stack your wide-brimmed fedoras, baseball caps, or cowboy hats in style and well-organized with our exquisite large, foldable hat storage box. Made of premium quality felt fabric, our hat holder has a transparent cover and strong zipper to protect your headwear from dust and other damage.

👒 HIGH-QUALITY FELT FABRIC: Our hat holder organizer is made of high-density felt, which is stronger, thicker, and yet lightweight to ensure it lasts for years. It is dirt resistant, odorless, and capable of holding a good amount of weight. It has good abrasion resistance and won’t be damaged by a hat's tip or any hard objects.

👒 LARGE SIZE & ROUND SHAPE WITH STRAP: Our collapsible hat box is spacious enough to comfortably fit 18-inch hats and can easily accommodate 6 - 10 of them, depending on the size. The shape of our hat box organizer is round with dimensions 19" x 11.5" (diameter x tall) and includes a sturdy strap (with reinforced stitching) to make it easy for you to carry anywhere during traveling.

👒 MULTIPURPOSE & CONVENIENT: While our large hat storage box is apt for travel and wardrobe storage, it can also store almost anything — from stuffed animal toys, baby items to scarves, bed sheets, towels, blankets, and more. This is an ideal multifunctional storage bag that meets various storage demands. It can be easily folded and collapsed flat for storage when not in use.
